endpoints.desc: Reads all settings for a component from its package.json. Returns the full settings schema with current default values.

params.name: id
params.desc: Component ID as registered in registry

examples.title: Node.js

endpoints.desc: Updates a single setting's default value in the component's manifest file. Preserves original YAML schema structure and invalidates the .bin cache automatically.

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

payload = {
    "type": "plugin",
    "id": "cluaiz-search",
    "key": "search_api_key",
    "value": "tvly-test-123"
}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/v1/config/plugin/cluaiz-search/set', json=payload)
print(res.json())
